notes.title: Breaking Lockdown is part of Steam Scream Fest!
notes.notes:
In March 2020, the first Lockdown started due to COVID.

That's when I decided to focus on one goal: release a first (small) game on Steam. That's how Breaking Lockdown was born, a (too?) frustrating game required (too many?) skills, quite influenced by the fact in 2020, the outside world was hostile.

However, Breaking Lockdown is not only a dark game. Working on it was my way to (safely) break the lockdown, make concessions to release it in 12 weeks, and most importantly, realize I had to go full-time on game development.

As part of Steam Scream Fest, I've put Breaking Lockdown at -75%. So, if you guys want to show your support, buying the game and writing a review would mean a lot to me!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1336420/Breaking_Lockdown/

Another way of showing your support is to follow Wild Dose and add it to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555790/Wild_Dose/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37961964/7e3826320ff1c5dc69b07a10d01d4956051ac163.gif[/img]

Thanks in advance for your support! 

Maxime

notes.title: Wild Dose Demo - Major Update
notes.notes:
Use all available skills to complete quests and uncover the secrets of Eleftheria!

Main contents:
- a smoother and more psychological-horror version of the Loading Zone
- use the Technology skill to hack the tank terminal in Eleftheria

This Major Update (patches excepted) will be the last for several months. Being still a solo developer, it becomes complicated to maintain this demo while the full game has evolved in parallel.

Enjoy this update and don't forget to add Wild Dose to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555790/Wild_Dose/

Maxime
